about: Reference limits for the power and ground budget (cuore/services/power_budget.py). Volts of drop measured ACROSS a section of wiring that is carrying current. These are general automotive screening figures, NOT an FCA / Alfa Romeo specification: if the dealer gives an FCA figure for this car, it replaces these.

conditions.label: Engine off
conditions.hint: Little or no current flows, so a drop here proves nothing (GROUND_VOLTAGE_DROP_TEST.md section 1). Recorded for the baseline only; never judged.

conditions.label: Engine running
conditions.hint: Idle (or about 1500 rpm if idle voltage is unstable), no extra loads.

conditions.label: Running + loads on
conditions.hint: Engine running with loads switched on (for example blower and rear heater/defrost; the procedure's own example is high beam + blower maximum). Note the loads used.

conditions.label: Wiggling the harness
conditions.hint: Engine running, loads on, harness or connector wiggled by hand while watching the meter. A jump means an intermittent joint.

ground.label: Ground side
ground.basis: General guideline (outside fact): about 0.2 V or less on the ground side (Fluke starter-circuit voltage-drop page, as cited in GROUND_VOLTAGE_DROP_TEST.md section 5). The 0.10 V 'good' line is that document's own screening rule (inference), not a published specification.

feed.label: Positive / feed side
feed.basis: General guideline (outside fact): about 0.3 V on the positive side (Fluke, as cited in GROUND_VOLTAGE_DROP_TEST.md section 5). The 0.10 V 'good' line is that document's screening rule (inference).

total.basis: General guideline (outside fact): total acceptable drop 0.2 to 0.5 V, positive plus ground (Fluke, as cited in GROUND_VOLTAGE_DROP_TEST.md section 5). Applied here to the sum of the chain segments measured under one condition.

ground.why: The owner's G003A test: from the ground stud/terminal to the battery negative post, under load (GROUND_VOLTAGE_DROP_TEST.md section 4; touch the post itself, not the clamp).

battery.why: Doc section 4, measurement 1: battery negative cable, its terminal and the cable-to-block connection.
Doc section 4, measurement 2: engine-to-body ground strap(s).
Doc section 4, measurement 3: total body-side ground path, a cross-check of 1 and 2, so it is not added into the total.

limit.basis: Doc section 4 (optional measurement): any reading above about 0.05 V means a loose or corroded clamp.

battery.why: Doc section 4 (optional measurement): positive post to positive cable lug.
